title: Brothers, Mentors and Soldiers: Who Is This?
description: Three clues, four names. Spot the alchemists, soldiers and elders of the main cast, with the last clue written in Japanese.

questions.question: Which character is this?
clues: Holds the title of the Fullmetal Alchemist
Has a younger brother who also does alchemy
His name is written エドワード・エルリック in Japanese

questions.question: Which character is this?
clues: The younger brother of the Fullmetal Alchemist
Shares a surname with the lead alchemist
His name is written アルフォンス・エルリック in Japanese

questions.question: Which character is this?
clues: Known as the Flame Alchemist
A military officer
Lieutenant Riza Hawkeye serves under him

questions.question: Which character is this?
clues: Works as an automail mechanic
Her name is written ウィンリィ・ロックベル in Japanese
Appears in the main cast beside the two brothers

questions.question: Which character is this?
clues: Serves as a lieutenant
Her superior is the Flame Alchemist
Her name is written リザ・ホークアイ in Japanese

questions.question: Which character is this?
clues: Goes by the Strong Arm Alchemist
Part of the military allies of the main cast
His name is written アレックス・ルイ・アームストロング in Japanese

questions.question: Which character is this?
clues: Works in military intelligence
An officer and ally of the lead alchemists
His name is written マース・ヒューズ in Japanese

questions.question: Which character is this?
clues: Teaches alchemy to the two brothers
One of the elders of the story
Her name is written イズミ・カーティス in Japanese

questions.question: Which character is this?
clues: The father of the two brothers
One of the elders of their story
His name is written ヴァン・ホーエンハイム in Japanese

questions.question: Which character is this?
clues: A survivor of the Ishbalan people
Listed among the main cast
His name is written 傷の男（スカー） in Japanese

sources.title: Wikipedia: List of Fullmetal Alchemist characters

notes: Clues paraphrase the main cast fact (016, arc 1); all ten are level 0 characters. Tagged arc 1 only because the cited cast fact is arc 1 (C5 forces it).
